info.name: List All Burn Alerts for an SLO

params.name: datasetSlug
params.description: The dataset slug or use `__all__` for endpoints that support environment-wide operations.

params.name: slo_id
params.description: For use with the list endpoint to retrieve all burn alerts for a specified SLO.

items.docs: Get all burn alerts associated with the SLO specified in the `slo_id` query param. It is not currently possible to retrieve all burn alerts for a dataset, environment, or team.
